title: PostgreSQL internals, Part 5: query planning and EXPLAIN
tldr: How the PostgreSQL planner chooses a plan and how to read it: cost units and random_page_cost, row estimates from pg_stats and their arithmetic, scan and join methods, reading EXPLAIN ANALYZE with loops and buffers, fixing estimates with ANALYZE, targets and extended statistics, work_mem spills and parallel workers, pg_stat_statements and auto_explain, plan flips, correlated columns, the generic-plan switch after five executions, work_mem times connections, and an interview drill.
